scope: Local implementation and verification; release candidate remains draft.
request: Changing imported guide mileage must discard prior active attribution/review, retain the original snapshot, allow incomplete drafts and require a source/method plus review before Float Plan creation.
root_cause: The planner retained the prior method for positive mileage changes, while the backend rejected a blank method even for a planning draft.
fix: The UI clears the active method on each numeric transition. The server discards retained prior/imported method text, source IDs/dates and review on a numeric change, while accepting a different explicitly supplied replacement method in the same request. Positive changed mileage uses the existing member_entered kind. The immutable source snapshot is not updated.
